answers.why: Part of the capture skill: queues new work with the plugin's own meow command in one exchange, which no reader rule or skill does.

Capture skill's core procedure (pick idea/scoped/ready from the owner's signal, split, place, confirm); its 'never queue without their say-so' agrees with the reader rules, and nothing in the reader covers it.
Capture skill rule that a session asked for file-changing work queues and claims it first; reader has no equivalent.
Capture skill's rescue-session procedure ('queue everything unfinished'), plugin workflow the reader lacks.
Capture skill's riffing mode ('One line per idea') for an owner who is not reading replies; reader has nothing like it.
Capture skill's prompt-me pull, which gives open questions as a tap list; works with meow and has no reader counterpart.
Section the capture skill prints for prompt-me (recommend first, decision list, record answers); same skill, same reasoning.

The herd skill's dispatcher for pairs, hikes, handoffs and scaling; its session-start model default ('start the reviewer ... on opus') governs launching a session, not a subagent dispatch, so it does not meet the reader's subagent rule.
Associate role of the herd skill (domain, answer on the item); no reader equivalent.
Auditor role intro in the herd skill: 'try to prove a document ... wrong' at a pinned sha; reader has no audit procedure.
Auditor method (break the code, see a test fail, verdict BACKED/UNTESTED/CONTRADICTED) extends the reader's 'seen to fail' idea to doc claims, so it is not covered.
Auditor findings format and triage classes in the herd skill; reader has none.
Auditor hard rules ('No fixes', 'No pushes', scratch repos with HOME redirected) are safe and consistent with the reader's safety rules.
Auditor prompt-hygiene rules (one plain command per call); part of the same role and not in the reader.
Auditor report shape returned as the final message; part of the role.
Coordinator's checklist for running an audit (pin sha, one auditor per surface, merge, triage); reader has nothing similar.
Falsify item template that files one audit per area through meow add; part of the auditor role.
Bond role: two sessions review each other 'same bar'; herd skill content with no reader counterpart.
Handoff role intro in the herd skill, saying when a session hands off.
Retiring side of the handoff procedure; the reader has no handoff process.
Staying side of the handoff (read the readback, confirm or abandon); herd skill content.
New-session side of the handoff, including branch and checkout hygiene; herd skill content.
Plain-voice chat lines for each handoff step, part of the herd skill's handoff role.

Reviewer role header (identity, rigor, version check, repo rules file); its 'Never add a key, a token, an https remote' line is an auth rule the reader lacks but sits inside the herd skill.

Reviewer limits (binding verdict, no edits to the worker's code, queue-for-yourself, 'Never use `--force`'); consistent with the reader and absent from it.
Rules for who started the reviewer and how it stops; herd skill content.
Reviewer's rigor-build checklist ('Cite every claim you accept', 'Name the failure you fear'); extends the reader's test rule and is not in force.
